resource_rules.base_note_visible: The named note is visible under current workspace, deleted-state, and private-note rules; NOT_FOUND is used when visibility would leak existence.
resource_rules.delivery_recipient_only: The receipt consumer_id is derived only from AuthContext.agent_id. Callers cannot select another consumer or workspace; message_id may only narrow the caller's own receipt.
resource_rules.feedback_note_visible: The note is currently visible. If trace_id is supplied, the unexpired trace belongs to AuthContext.agent_id and contains that note; pin/unpin additionally requires owner/steward.
resource_rules.notes_mutable: Both notes are in AuthContext.workspace_id and each passes the existing note-service mutation/private-owner checks.
resource_rules.relation_endpoints_visible: A relation row is returned only when both endpoint notes are visible to the caller.
resource_rules.review_capability: The caller is the run initiator or owner/steward; accept/edit of rule, finance, owner-approved decision, or legal-classified content requires owner/steward.
resource_rules.run_initiator_or_admin: The caller initiated the extraction run or has owner/steward capability; candidates still expose only authorized source references.
resource_rules.session_range_visible: The session and every source message in the inclusive range are visible to the caller in AuthContext.workspace_id.
resource_rules.trace_caller_or_admin: The trace caller matches AuthContext.agent_id or the caller has owner/steward capability; every returned item is re-filtered through current result visibility.
resource_rules.workspace_export_admin: Caller has owner/steward capability; export scope is exactly AuthContext.workspace_id and cannot be selected by request input.
resource_rules.workspace_import_admin: Caller has owner/steward capability; target_workspace_id must equal AuthContext.workspace_id and artifact resolution is confined to the sanctioned export root.

authorization_contract.workspace_source: AuthContext.workspace_id only; request IDs never widen workspace

canonical_tools.description: List messages addressed to the calling agent. Messages are pushed into your turn automatically as they arrive, so this is a history view rather than something you must poll; if your client has no runtime to push to, listing them here is what delivers them. Whatever this returns is recorded as delivered. status filters by transport delivery state.
canonical_tools.name: agent_inbox

canonical_tools.description: List all agents in the workspace (or all workspaces for privileged steward). Returns name, type, active status, and last_seen.
canonical_tools.name: agent_list

canonical_tools.description: Create a new agent with optional bootstrap notes from a role preset. Returns the API key ONCE — it is never stored or logged in plaintext. If a role preset is specified, bootstrap notes are created and a thin system prompt is returned ready for copy-paste.

role.description: Optional role preset for bootstrap notes. Available: general, family, ops-kz, smm

canonical_tools.name: agent_onboard

canonical_tools.description: Reply within an existing session. If to_agent is omitted the most recent other party is used. Set close=true to close the session after sending.
canonical_tools.name: agent_reply

canonical_tools.description: Send a message to another agent. It is delivered into the recipient's turn automatically; nothing has to be acknowledged. Agents in your own workspace are matched first; a name that is unique instance-wide also reaches an agent in another workspace (memory, notes and recall stay private to each). Creates a new session if session_id is omitted. Supply idempotency_key to make retries return the original send.

topic.description: Used only when creating a new session.

canonical_tools.name: agent_send

canonical_tools.description: Close an open agent session. Status flips to 'closed' and timestamps are stamped; the close action is logged in the activity audit.
canonical_tools.name: agent_session_close

canonical_tools.description: Open a new agent-to-agent session with a topic. Optionally seed it atomically with an initial message by passing to_agent + message. Supply idempotency_key to make retries return the original session.
canonical_tools.name: agent_session_create

canonical_tools.description: Change an agent's MCP tool risk profile. Profiles: 'read-only' (only risk='read' tools), 'no-destructive' (read + write-low), 'full' (every tool the agent's type qualifies for). Steward-only. Refuses to demote the caller (self-lockout) or the last active full-profile steward in the workspace (workspace lockout). Activates on the next MCP request — current in-flight requests are not interrupted.

name.description: Name of the agent whose profile is being changed

canonical_tools.name: agent_set_profile

canonical_tools.description: List active agents in the workspace. Pass 'agent' to look up a single name; that lookup also finds an agent in another workspace when the name is unique instance-wide, flagged with external_workspace.

canonical_tools.description: Workspace snapshot: open tasks, recent notes, active deals, agent activity. Call at session start to restore context.

project.description: Project ULID or exact project note text

canonical_tools.description: Add a directed link between two entities in the same workspace (Phase 2 Item C). Idempotent on (source, target, relation_type). Self-loops forbidden. canonical_tools.description: Render an entity page as markdown with title, summary, metadata, and inline outgoing/incoming link sections (Phase 2 Item C). Body capped at 32 KiB; secrets are detected and refused via assertNoSecrets.

canonical_tools.description: Search entity pages (Phase 2 Item C). With `query`, runs FTS5 on entity_pages_fts. Without, lists by type/status. Returns title + truncated 240-char summary preview.

canonical_tools.name: entity_upsert

canonical_tools.description: Build a privileged read-only count and policy plan for the caller's workspace; no row body is returned.
canonical_tools.name: export_plan

canonical_tools.description: Create or reuse an idempotent extraction proposal run. It never writes canonical notes or entities.
canonical_tools.name: extraction_preview

canonical_tools.description: Accept, edit, or reject one candidate with optimistic concurrency. Only accept/edit creates a canonical note.

canonical_tools.description: Read one uploaded file by id, or by folder + filename. Returns inline text for text/markdown/docx/pdf; for other binary returns metadata + a dashboard download_path. Workspace-scoped.
canonical_tools.name: file_get

canonical_tools.description: List files the owner uploaded via the dashboard into named folders. Optional folder / owner filters. Workspace-scoped. Returns metadata (id, folder, filename, mime, size, readable).
canonical_tools.name: file_list

canonical_tools.description: Validate one sanctioned export artifact for the caller's workspace and return conflicts. Applying an import is never an MCP operation.

task_bound_id.description: Bind this note to a task; auto-purged when task closes.

visibility.description: ADR-014: 'workspace' (default) shares note with all agents in this workspace. 'private' restricts reads to this agent and admin types.

canonical_tools.name: note_create

canonical_tools.description: Soft-delete a note (sets deleted_at).
canonical_tools.name: note_delete

canonical_tools.description: Fetch a single note by ULID.
canonical_tools.name: note_get

canonical_tools.description: List notes with filters: type, project_id, agent, status (from metadata), tags, date range, session.
canonical_tools.name: note_list

canonical_tools.description: List visible V4 relations for one note after workspace and private-note authorization.
canonical_tools.name: note_relation_list

canonical_tools.description: Atomically link a current note to the prior note, mirror legacy metadata, and archive the prior note without deleting it.
canonical_tools.name: note_supersede

canonical_tools.description: Update a note. Metadata merges shallowly by default; use metadata_replace to fully replace.
canonical_tools.name: note_update

canonical_tools.description: Full-text search across notes, activity log, and session messages. Returns results with complete text (no truncation). Default is hybrid-only (FTS5 + bge-m3 vector channel fused via RRF, ~50ms, no external sidecar). Opt-in `deep=true` adds a cross-encoder rerank stage (~1.5s) that reorders top candidates by pair-wise relevance; `deep_llm=true` instead invokes the Claude-Haiku LLM judge (~5-17s, sharper on tricky mono-term / cross-language queries). Both rerank paths are bounded by their timeout env and fall back to raw RRF order on sidecar failure.

deep.description: Cross-encoder rerank on top of the hybrid pool (~1.5s). Default OFF unless server has QOOPIA_RERANK_DEFAULT_DEEP=1. Set true to opt in per call; set false to force raw RRF order even when the env default is on.

deep_llm.description: LLM-judge rerank via Claude Haiku sidecar (~5-15s). Opt-in for tricky / high-precision recall; overrides `deep`.

explain.description: Return bounded score components and reason codes for visible results only. Requires QOOPIA_V4_RECALL_EXPLAIN.

include_archived.description: Include notes whose metadata.status='archived'. Default false — archived rows hidden to keep results focused.

include_history.description: Relation audit mode. true requires include_archived=true, forces effective latest_only=false when omitted, and is incompatible with explicit latest_only=true.

latest_only.description: Return active supersede heads only. Effective default remains false until QOOPIA_V4_LATEST_ONLY is enabled. include_history=true forces false when omitted and rejects explicit true.

lifecycle.description: Per-call lifecycle override. true requires QOOPIA_V4_LIFECYCLE; false disables lifecycle for this call.

query.description: Full-text keywords. Use multiple terms to narrow.

scope.description: notes (default) | activity (audit log) | sessions (conversation messages) | all (union of the three).

trace.description: Persist a privacy-safe bounded trace and return its opaque ID. Requires QOOPIA_V4_RECALL_EXPLAIN.

canonical_tools.name: recall

canonical_tools.description: Record bounded feedback for a visible note. pin and unpin require owner or steward capability.
canonical_tools.name: recall_feedback

canonical_tools.description: Read one bounded privacy-safe recall trace scoped to its caller or an authorized admin.
canonical_tools.name: recall_trace_get

canonical_tools.description: Fetch raw messages by ID range (expand a prior summary).
canonical_tools.name: session_expand

canonical_tools.description: Load recent messages from a session. Pass session_id='latest' to get the most recent session of this agent.

canonical_tools.description: Save your own summary of a message range. Qoopia does not generate summaries — you write the text.

tested_at.description: ISO timestamp when the runbook was last verified.

tester_agent.description: Agent slug that ran the verification.

canonical_tools.name: skill_mark_tested

canonical_tools.description: Render a skill as an actionable markdown runbook (Phase 2 Item E). Sections: Trigger, Prerequisites, Steps, Verification, Failure modes, Rollback, Code paths, Related incidents. Operators paste the output into a session log when they run the skill.
canonical_tools.name: skill_render_runbook

canonical_tools.description: Search skill entities (Phase 2 Item E). Pins type='skill' so the caller cannot accidentally widen across entity types. With `query`, FTS5 on entity_pages_fts; without, lists by status. Returns title + 240-char summary preview.
canonical_tools.name: skill_search

canonical_tools.description: Insert or update a skill runbook entity (Phase 2 Item E). Wraps entity_upsert with type='skill' and validates the full metadata shape (skill_version, trigger_conditions, exact_steps, verification_gates, failure_modes, rollback, related_code_paths, related_incidents). Idempotent on (workspace, slug). Workspace pinned from auth.

metadata.description: Required skill metadata. See SKILL_METADATA_REQUIRED in src/services/skills.ts.

summary.description: Required for skills — renders as the runbook intro.

canonical_tools.name: skill_upsert

compatibility.feature_disabled_policy: An explicitly requested gated option returns FEATURE_DISABLED; it is never silently enabled or ignored.
compatibility.mcp_error_envelope: isError=true with stable CODE: message text; no internal stack or secret
